title: Chapter 296: You Want to Scare Me?
html:
A suicide alone might not have frightened away every tenant, but the dead man’s severed arm remained missing. No one dared move in, terrified that it might reach from some hidden corner while they cleaned.

“I still want to take a look,” Chen Ge said calmly, like this was nothing serious to him.

“All right.” Cold sweat had soaked a patch across the back of the agent’s shirt. “The apartment itself is quite good. An identical unit at the Electrical Plant Residence costs four times as much.”

The open door released a musty, mildewed odor. The agent worked the living-room switch several times before the long-unused light finally flickered on and pushed back the darkness. Chen Ge entered without ceremony. He had only one purpose: find the drawer.

The black phone provided a description of the drawer. It sounds like it belongs to the desk in the bedroom.

Before the agent could stop him, Chen Ge entered the first bedroom. Yet neither bedroom contained a desk—only large wardrobes.

The description is different to what’s described by the phone.

Chen Ge walked out from the bedroom and glanced at the agent with confusion. “Brother, are you sure this is Room 304?”

“That’s what the key says. There can’t be a mistake.” The agent showed him its label. Although the bedrooms lacked desks, other rooms contained several pieces with drawers. Searching them properly will take time. Will I really have to stay overnight?

“What do you think of the room? We can still discuss the price.” The man was afraid; he stood at the door and did not dare enter.

“I like this room a lot. Can you let me stay here for a night?” Chen Ge reached into his backpack to search for something.

“Stay overnight? We don’t offer that service. If you aren’t satisfied, why don’t we view the apartment next door?”

“No. I want this one.” Chen Ge interrupted and produced his identification and five hundred yuan. “Five hundred for one night, and you can keep my ID. I won’t damage anything. If nothing strange happens, I’ll rent the apartment.”

The agent had not seen this kind of customer before. “I’m sorry, but the company has rules that I need to follow.”

“Do you have many people asking for it? If you turn me away, who knows how long it will remain vacant?” Eventually, Chen Ge persuaded the agent to leave him the key.

“There are security cameras throughout the compound. If anything happens, run outside. I’ll return tomorrow at eight in the morning.”

“You’d better come sooner because I have something else to do in the morning.” Chen Ge sent the agent out. Looking at the key in his hand, he felt something was off. The key itself was old, but the tape was new.

This is weird.

A noise from the kitchen interrupted his thoughts. Chen Ge drew the hammer and entered to find that a cleaver had fallen from the chopping block into the sink.

Where was this cleaver earlier?

He examined the cleaver, then ignited the gas burner. Holding its wooden handle, he heated the blade over the flame. Baleful Specters should fear fire, shouldn’t they?

The bright knife was burned until it was charred. Chen Ge then dropped it back into the sink.

There are so many drawers, but one of them has to be one I’m looking for.

He switched on every light and began searching for a drawer that refused to open. Night had fallen, and the compound was unnaturally silent, as though every apartment stood empty.

An hour slipped by unnoticed. Chen Ge sat in the living room amid the drawers he had removed.

All of the drawers in this place can be opened. There’s nothing out of the ordinary with them.

As he leaned against the sofa, exhaustion crept over him. He had not slept properly in days.

This is different from my previous draws at the wheel. Is it because the Specter is particularly powerful? Or does it have a special power?

He placed the recorder beside him and fell asleep on the sofa, hugging the hammer. He was about to close his eyes when his phone rang.

The real-estate agency? Why would they call now?Chen Ge answered, and the familiar woman spoke. “Hello. I’m sorry, but we’ve just learned that the agent responsible for the Third Hospital Staff Residence was involved in an accident on his way to meet you. He cannot assist you tonight. If you remain interested, please return in three days.”

An accident?Every trace of drowsiness vanished. If the agent had never arrived, who had shown him the apartment? A Baleful Specter haunting the compound, or the agent’s wandering soul? Either way, Chen Ge had met a ghost.

“Can you describe the appearance of the agent?”

“I’m sorry, but I’m only responsible for customer service. I’m not really familiar with the individual agents in Jiujiang.”

“You don’t know your own company’s agents?” Chen Ge studied the key left by the ghost. The longer he looked, the stranger it seemed. New tape covered an old key. Peeling it back revealed three crooked digits underneath: 305.

The apartment he tried to show me first was the real Room 304. The genuinely haunted room was the one he wanted me to rent!

Chen Ge’s irrational insistence must have caught the ghost off guard. Ordinary people avoided haunted rooms, but this ‘customer’ had stubbornly demanded to enter one.

“I’m sorry, is there anything else I can help you with?” The woman on the phone was very nice, and her tone was polite.

“Your agency should have records for the apartment. Could you check Room 304’s previous tenants? I know the place is haunted, and the low price is exactly why I’m interested, so there’s no need to conceal anything.”

“All right,” the woman replied promptly. “Room 304 had three previous tenants. The third was a gambler. When he failed to repay loan sharks, they severed one of his arms. Cornered, he eventually jumped from the building. The second tenant was an English teacher who mysteriously disappeared inside the apartment. The first tenant…”

Chen Ge focused on the phone when there was a knock on the door.

Someone is outside? At this time?Chen Ge grabbed the hammer and muttered into the phone, “Please snap a picture of that information and send it to me. I’m definitely taking this place!”
